testCases.input: What is Exact Match in LLM evaluation?
testCases.actualOutput: In LLM evaluation, Exact Match checks whether the model's output equals the gold answer. It is suitable for closed tasks such as classification or short-answer QA, but is brittle for free text.

testCases.name: test_case_1
testCases.input: What does Recall@k measure in retrieval?
testCases.actualOutput: Recall@k measures the fraction of relevant documents found in the top k results. It is considered the most important retrieval metric because anything that is not retrieved cannot be used by the LLM.
testCases.expectedOutput: Recall@k is the fraction of relevant documents found in the top k retrieved results.
retrievalContext: Recall@k is the fraction of relevant documents found in the top k results, and Hit rate asks whether at least one was found; this is the most important retrieval metric, because anything not retrieved cannot be used by the LLM.
